TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACID,BANK_ID,TRAN_DATE_BAL,TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN,VALUE_DATE_BAL,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN,END_EOD_DATE,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,EAB_CRNCY_CODE,EOD_DATE))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE,END_EOD_DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS FILE_NAME
FROM (	 SELECT [ACID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[EOD_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') AS EOD_DATE
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_DATE_BAL],' ',''),''),0)) as TRAN_DATE_BAL
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN],' ',''),''),0)) as TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VALUE_DATE_BAL],' ',''),''),0)) as VALUE_DATE_BAL
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN],' ',''),''),0)) as VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[END_EOD_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') AS END_EOD_DATE
,[LCHG_USER_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as [LCHG_TIME]
,[RCRE_USER_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as [RCRE_TIME]
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TS_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as TS_CNT
,[EAB_CRNCY_CODE]
,[BANK_ID]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
FROM [D360].[STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20231205]
where H = 'D'
) A), TGT AS	
(	SELECT
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACID,BANK_ID,TRAN_DATE_BAL,TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN,VALUE_DATE_BAL,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN,END_EOD_DATE,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,EAB_CRNCY_CODE,EOD_DATE))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE,END_EOD_DATE
FROM	BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE 


)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ACID,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE,END_EOD_DATE,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACID,TGT.ACID) AS ACID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.EOD_DATE,TGT.EOD_DATE) AS EOD_DATE
	,SRC.END_EOD_DATE
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL AND SRC.EOD_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL AND SRC.EOD_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
	    WHEN SRC.FILE_NAME <  CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.EOD_DATE,112)  OR SRC.HASHROW = TGT.HASHROW OR (SRC.EOD_DATE = TGT.EOD_DATE AND SRC.END_EOD_DATE = TGT.END_EOD_DATE) THEN 'DELETE'
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
LEFT JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND	SRC.EOD_DATE = TGT.EOD_DATE;

Update BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE set isLatest = 0  where  concat(ACID,BANK_ID,'')  in (select concat(ACID,BANK_ID,'')  from BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA where record_status = 'UPDATE') and isLatest = 1;

/******************STG to BUSC************************/
SELECT STG.[ACID]
,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[EOD_DATE]) AS EOD_DATE
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_DATE_BAL],' ',''),''),0)) as TRAN_DATE_BAL
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN],' ',''),''),0)) as TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VALUE_DATE_BAL],' ',''),''),0)) as VALUE_DATE_BAL
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN],' ',''),''),0)) as VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[END_EOD_DATE]) AS END_EOD_DATE
,[LCHG_USER_ID]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as [LCHG_TIME]
,[RCRE_USER_ID]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as [RCRE_TIME]
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TS_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as TS_CNT
,[EAB_CRNCY_CODE]
,STG.[BANK_ID]
,CASE WHEN DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'DELETE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as isActive
,CASE WHEN (STG.[END_EOD_DATE] = 20991231 OR STG.[EOD_DATE] = LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS   <> 'DELETE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
FROM [BUSC].[DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA] DELTA
LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20231205] STG ON DELTA.ACID = STG.ACID AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID AND DELTA.EOD_DATE = STG.EOD_DATE
where H = 'D' and stg.acid = 'PA2321346'  --AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS in( 'INSERT','UPDATE')

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD AS (
-- EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date & TRAN_DATE_BAL
SELECT distinct
	CASE WHEN BDG.FORACID IS NULL THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,BDE.ACID)  ELSE BDG.FORACID END AS CustomerAccountId
	,'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BDE.EOD_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BDE.END_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BDE.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS BalanceAmount
	,convert(varchar,BDE.EAB_CRNCY_CODE) AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,convert(varchar,BDE.BANK_ID) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,NULL AS PeriodMonthYear
	,NULL AS PeriodQuarterYear
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BDE.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_CM49_20240104_day2 BDE 
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG 
	ON BDE.ACID = BDG.ACID
	AND BDE.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID
	AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1
--WHERE BDE.FILE_NAME >= CONVERT(VARCHAR,BDE.EOD_DATE,112)
WHERE BDE.ISLATEST = 1 --and BDE.acid = 'PA3937186' 
)

WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId),
	convert(varchar,PeriodBalanceTypeId),
	CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)),
	CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodEndDate)),
	convert(numeric,BalanceAmount),
	convert(varchar,IsoCurrencyCode),
	convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
	)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode,PeriodStartDate
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId),
	convert(varchar,PeriodBalanceTypeId),
	CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)),
	CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodEndDate)),
	convert(numeric,BalanceAmount),
	convert(varchar,IsoCurrencyCode),
	convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
	)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode,PeriodStartDate

FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TEST_20240105_daily WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' 
and 	PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31' 
AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'-- and customeraccountid = 'e018f102aeb70634df4da62d508ec7ab' -- AND 1=0
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId,TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId) AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartDate,TGT.PeriodStartDate) AS PeriodStartDate
	,CASE   WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE' 
			ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 

--WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BANK_ID,ACID,PREVIOUS_CURRBAL,PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL,CURRENT_EOD_DATE,ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL,ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID
FROM (	SELECT [BANK_ID] ,[ACID] ,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PREVIOUS_CURRBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as PREVIOUS_CURRBAL ,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[CURRENT_EOD_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as CURRENT_EOD_DATE ,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL ,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL ,1 as isActive ,1 as isLatest ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE] ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE] ,[FILE_NAME] ,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm FROM [D360].[STG_DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES] where H = 'D'
) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BANK_ID,ACID,PREVIOUS_CURRBAL,PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL,CURRENT_EOD_DATE,ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL,ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID
FROM	BUSC.DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES
WHERE	isLatest = 1
)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ACID,BANK_ID,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACID,TGT.ACID) AS ACID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	
	,CASE WHEN SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL AND SRC.ACID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL AND SRC.ACID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.ACID IN (SELECT ACID FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE DEL_FLG = 'Y') THEN 'DELETE'
	    WHEN TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL AND TGT.ACID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
	ELSE 'UPDATE' END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
	
WHERE	(

TGT.ACID IS NULL
OR	TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
